Compare a copy with the digest before you rely on it. They are rendered in dist/spec/evals-baseline/1.0.html and, as a markdown list, in the sidecar dist/spec/evals-baseline/1.0.md. Both are true: the build refuses a copy that differs from the file it was copied from whenever that file is on the machine, and the digest beside each file is the SHA-256 of the bytes served, which npm run gate:agents compares with the file in dist for the page and for the sidecar. The instruction to compare a copy with the digest is one the reader can follow with shasum -a 256. Re-read on 2026-11-15 after the move of the implementation checkout out of this repository. Three new strings were added, and none of them is page copy: no checkout at <path>, which mirror.json declares as <value>, the summary line mirrors: N declared, M compared, K not compared; nothing was compared with an upstream file, and the per-skip line not compared: <file>: <reason>. All three are written to the terminal by npm run gate:agents through mirrorSummary, never to a route; grep of dist for each of them returns nothing, and the editorial gate reports two of them under source copy no page ships for that reason. They are verified as operator text: each names the path it looked for and the declared value beside it, so a reader can tell an absent sibling checkout from a mistyped one without reading the source.
